sloka: आरुह्य च रथं शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ।ययतु: परमप्रीतौ वृतौ मन्त्रिपुरोहितै: ॥ २.११५.९॥
transliteration: āruhya ca rathaṁ śīghraṁ śatrughnabharatāvubhau।yayatu: paramaprītau vṛtau mantripurohitai: ॥ 2.115.9॥

translations.english: Highly pleased, Bharata and Satrughna ascended the chariot and, surrounded by counsellors and priests, set out speedily.
